about_the_game:
Tired of stealing snacks, the crows have decided to grow their own!
In this charming, turn-based farming game, time only moves when you do, so you set the pace. Whether you prefer to plan every move or just vibe through your day, the choice is yours.

Start small with a single crow, working the land one tile at a time: tilling, planting, and watering by claw and beak. As your farm grows, you can recruit a team of helpful birds—each ready to take on tasks and help automate your growing operation.

Build cozy treehouse workshops to process your goods into more valuable products, and upgrade everything from your crops to your feathered friends to your production lines. With the right setup, your bird-powered farm will run like clockwork.

Manage your flock, upgrade your systems, and watch your humble garden grow into a bustling bird-run business!

This project is still in early development.

Visuals, gameplay, and content shown here are subject to change.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 or greater
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or equivalent
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD 4000 or better
  • Storage: 500 MB available space

short_description: The crows are done stealing—now they’re farming! Start with a single clever crow and grow your bird-run farm from scratch. Plant crops, expand your land, and recruit other hardworking birds to help you build a feathery farming empire.
